meadow.win.title: Home, sweet burrow!

task.dawn.body: {name} held the burrow through the night.

task.footer.keys: W A S D move · R dash · P pause

story.chapter.ch2.title: Journey on Moon

story.path.taglineArt: Painted map. Nodes sit on the dirt platforms.
story.path.taglineW0: Burrow Eve, then Moon in the Pool teaches hop in play.
story.world.w0.title: Burrow Eve
story.world.w0.tagline: Setting, moon lore, and soft paws.
story.world.w1.title: Meadow and Hedgerows
story.world.w1.tagline: Soft paths, hedges, and Fox Hu's cart.
story.world.w2.title: Bamboo and River
story.world.w2.tagline: Dusk water and tall green walls.
story.world.w3.title: Lantern Peak
story.world.w3.tagline: Festival lights and a tiger road.
story.world.w4.title: Cloud Stair
story.world.w4.tagline: Wind, frost, and the last walk before the palace.
story.world.moon.title: Guanghan Palace
story.world.moon.tagline: Vast Cold. Duck, eat, dash Han.
story.world.ch2_outer.title: Outer Cold
story.world.ch2_outer.tagline: Palace gardens. The cold still holds.
story.world.ch2_cassia.title: Cassia Wound
story.world.ch2_cassia.tagline: The tree will not stay cut.
story.world.ch2_mortar.title: Mortar Yard
story.world.ch2_mortar.tagline: Pestle and cakes. Not a kitchen.
story.world.ch2_dust.title: Dust Sea
story.world.ch2_wells.title: Quiet Wells
story.world.ch2_silver.title: Far Silver
story.world.ch2_silver.tagline: A quiet basin under the moon.
story.world.ch3_shore.title: Other Shore
story.world.ch3_water.title: Weak Water
story.world.ch3_ridges.title: Hanging Ridges
story.world.ch3_peach.title: Peach Rows
story.world.ch3_grotto.title: Grotto Heaven
story.world.ch3_pool.title: West Pool
story.station.w0_setting.title: Burrow Eve
story.station.w0_setting.blurb: Mid-Autumn. An osmanthus blossom falls glowing.
story.station.w0_setting.line0: Mid-Autumn eve. An osmanthus blossom drifts down glowing.
story.station.w0_setting.line1: Yue chases it. Mei watches from the burrow mouth.
story.station.w0_lore_moon.title: Moon in the Pool
story.station.w0_lore_moon.line0: Mei runs to the pond. Chang'e answers through the water.
story.station.w0_lore_moon.line1: Follow the blossoms. Each night I will light a pool for you.
story.level.w0_lore_moon.name: Moon in the Pool
story.level.w0_lore_moon.objective: Reach the puddle. Hear the Moon. Reach the tiny exit.
story.level.w0_lore_moon.moon: Follow the blossoms. Each night I will light a pool for you.
story.level.w0_controls.name: Soft Paws
story.level.w0_controls.objective: Walk, jump, and dash. Meet a few meadow friends. Reach the burrow.
story.level.w0_controls.moon: Soft paws remember soft grass. The burrow waits ahead.
story.level.w1_1_soft_paths.name: Soft Paths
story.level.w1_1_soft_paths.objective: Reach the burrow. Soft grass remembers soft paws.
story.level.w1_2_hedge_maze.name: Hedge Maze
story.level.w1_2_hedge_maze.objective: Climb the ledges. Bounce off hedges to keep hopping.
story.level.w1_2_hedge_maze.moon: Hedges hold secrets. Bounce, little hopper.
story.level.w1_3_cart_chase.name: Cart Chase
story.level.w1_3_cart_chase.objective: Beat Fox Hu's cart to the burrow basket.
story.level.w1_3_cart_chase.moon: Fox Hu runs. The basket waits at home.
story.level.w2_1_green_corridor.name: Green Corridor
story.level.w2_1_green_corridor.objectiv: Climb the bamboo shafts. Bounce off the green walls.
story.level.w2_1_green_corridor.moon: She is safe above the clouds. Climb when the water turns silver.
story.level.w2_2_floating_logs.name: Floating Logs
story.level.w2_2_floating_logs.objective: Hop the floating logs. The river carries you gently.
story.level.w2_2_floating_logs.moon: Ride the silver water. Soft paws on soft wood.
story.level.w2_3_raft_gauntlet.name: Raft Gauntlet
story.level.w2_3_raft_gauntlet.objective: Dash the flying Heron Fisher three times, then hop the burrow log.
story.level.w2_3_raft_gauntlet.moon: The heron watches the silver current. Soft dash, soft win.
story.level.w3_1_paper_lights.name: Paper Lights
story.level.w3_1_paper_lights.objective: Hold jump to glide between lantern platforms.
story.level.w3_1_paper_lights.moon: Lanterns lift soft paws. Hold the jump and float.
story.level.w3_2_tiger_road.name: Tiger Road
story.level.w3_2_tiger_road.objective: Wait for the tiger, hop on, and ride across the water.
story.level.w3_2_tiger_road.moon: Lord Rabbit's tiger knows the blossom road.
story.level.w3_3_crane_summit.name: Crane Summit
story.level.w3_3_crane_summit.objective: Dodge the dives. When the Crane bows, ride to the Cloud Stair.
story.level.w3_3_crane_summit.moon: The messenger bows. A ride waits at the foot of the stair.
story.level.w4_1_first_steps.name: First Steps
story.level.w4_1_first_steps.objective: Climb the first cloud steps. Cross one hanging bridge.
story.level.w4_1_first_steps.moon: The steps turn guests back. Keep your paws on the stone.
story.level.w4_2_no_return.name: No Return
story.level.w4_2_no_return.objective: Climb. A fall into the cloud restarts the station.
story.level.w4_2_no_return.moon: There is no pool on these steps.
story.level.w4_3_closing_gale.name: Closing Gale
story.level.w4_3_closing_gale.objective: Reach the palace gate before the gale closes.
story.level.w4_3_closing_gale.moon: The old cold turns guests. Walk anyway.
story.level.moon_guanghan.name: Guanghan
story.level.moon_guanghan.objective: Duck the frost. Eat a mooncake, then dash Han.
story.level.moon_guanghan.moon: The old cold kept guests. I did not.
story.level.ch2_outer_1_courtyard.name: Frost Courtyard
story.level.ch2_outer_1_courtyard.object: Hop out of the palace gardens.
story.level.ch2_outer_1_courtyard.moon: The roofs end. The cold does not.
story.level.ch2_cassia_1_grove.name: Grove Cut
story.level.ch2_cassia_1_grove.moon: The tree closes every cut. Hop the wound.
story.level.ch2_mortar_1_bowls.name: Stone Bowls
story.level.ch2_mortar_1_bowls.objective: Hop the bowl rims. Pound, do not cook.
story.level.ch2_mortar_1_bowls.moon: Pound, do not cook. Cakes keep the time.
story.level.ch2_dust_1_rims.name: Rim Walk
story.level.ch2_dust_1_rims.moon: Dust remembers every paw. Keep to the rims.
story.level.ch2_wells_1_mouths.name: Cave Mouths
story.level.ch2_wells_1_mouths.objective: Hop the cave lips. One well waits below.
story.level.ch2_wells_1_mouths.moon: Still water. Not the far one.
story.level.ch2_silver_1_basin.name: Quiet Basin
story.level.ch2_silver_1_basin.objective: Hop the sparse pads to a still shore.
story.level.ch2_silver_1_basin.moon: This water still speaks. Farther is quieter.
story.dead.title: A soft tumble
story.dead.pool: Continue from the last Moon Pool.
story.dead.fallPool: Fall gently. Continue from the last Moon Pool.
story.dead.fallStart: Fall gently. Continue from the start.
story.dead.cloud: The cloud took you. Begin the stair again.
story.dead.gale: The gale closed in. Begin the stair again.
story.dead.waterPool: The river is soft. Continue from the last Moon Pool.
story.dead.waterStart: The river is soft. Continue from the start.
story.dead.fox: Fox Hu's cart reached the basket first. Soft paws, try again.
story.win.title: Path clear
story.win.w0: Paws ready. Soft Paths opens on the map.
story.win.w1: Fox Hu is foiled. World 1 rests.
story.win.w3: The Crane Envoy offers a ride to the Cloud Stair.
story.win.w4: The gale yields. Guanghan waits above.
story.seed.set: Full set. Every seed fleck is open.
story.exit.fox: Beat Fox Hu's cart to the burrow.
story.exit.gale: Reach the palace gate before the gale.
story.exit.crane: Dodge the dives until the Crane bows.
story.exit.han: Eat a mooncake, then dash Han.
story.han.line.full: Stay. The roofs remember every guest.
story.han.line.beaten: The palace keeps a moon, not a guest.
story.crane.line0: The Crane Envoy bows. It knows the mistake.
story.epilogue.0: Yue plays under Wu Gang's tree with the Jade Rabbit.
story.epilogue.1: Chang'e asks Mei to stay. The palace is quiet and lonely.
story.epilogue.2: Mei offers a mooncake and a promise: every full moon the burrow will wave.
story.epilogue.3: The Crane Envoy carries them home. Kits watch the moon together.
endless.lobby.title: Meadow Run
endless.lobby.tagline: Run right. The mist chases. Environments shift from meadow to the peak.
endless.lobby.scores: Scores stay on this device. Each difficulty keeps only its top 10 runs.
endless.lobby.empty: No runs yet on {diff}. Best overall: {best} m.
endless.lobby.top: Local top 10 on {diff}. Runs below 10th are dropped.
endless.lobby.col.name: Name
endless.hint.glide: Hold jump to glide between lanterns.
endless.end.beasts: The mist and beasts win this time.
endless.end.water: A cold splash ends the run.
